title: Data Detective
description: Solve mysteries with data! Dot the fox detective hands you case files: sort and group a table until the answer pops out, pick the chart that answers the question, judge whether a claim is supported or too early to tell, clean up messy lists, compare fairly with percent, refine a model until it fits the trials (and balance a runner game), spot biased surveys and who was left out, and tally your own class survey into a chart and a fair claim. The Show-me rule: pin a claim only when the view supports it, then tap the evidence. Explorer and Pro cases, stars, a daily challenge, no typing.
notes: Built on the Oomba Kit 1.1.2 (pinned kit tag plus the art-props, dress and style-bold packs; Would You Rather pattern): a kit stage (forest, props, Dot = kit fox with glasses and an inline SVG trench coat on her DOM portrait) behind DOM case cards appended to Oomba.ui.root(); the kit's title (audit-visible Play), dialogs (case files and learn cards with Dot's portrait), quiz card (the Case-closed concept check in lesson mode), results (Oomba.ui.win), pause (P / Esc / HUD button, bound by the game since it does not use Oomba.game) and settings (title corner and the Quest Card gear). Levels are data: window.DataDetectiveLevels (CHAPTERS, LEVELS, NAMES, VERDICTS, allStrings) and a pure engine window.DataDetectiveEngine (newCase(level, seed) -> state; act(level, state, action) for sort / group / view / bar / set / slider / pct / fix / merge / remove / claim / show / hint / skip; evidence(); stars(); series(); visibleRows()) in the first classic script, vm-loadable, no DOM. Every case: case file dialog, a data view (DOM table with sort-by-header buttons and data-fit-dense rows, grouped counts, bar chart or pictograph as role=img bars with printed values, never canvas), tools (Group by, Table / Bars / Pictures, +/- steppers, a prediction slider, a row panel with Fix to / Merge / Remove / Keep, a percent toggle), Dot's panel (hints and what the data actually shows after a wrong claim) and the claim card. Show-me rule: the claim card opens only when the evidence view on screen supports it (engine.evidence), and a right claim is accepted once the player taps the evidence rows or bars (level.proof). Stars: 1 solved, 2 well made (edits within par, no wrong claim, no good row removed), 3 no tier-3 hint; Skip appears after two failed claims (0 stars, unlocks the next case). Chapters (quest code index): 1 sort (6), 2 chart (5), 3 claims (6), 4 cleanup (6), 5 models (5: a rule slider, seeded batches of trials from a fixed set of offsets dealt per seed so a rule's error is the same for every seed, one run = one refinement counted against par, case 5 Game Balance tunes a jump so 16 of 20 seeded test runs finish), 6 fair (4: a one-grade sample, who is missing, a system that fails for some users by percent, and a pick-two claim for the groups to survey next), 7 my-data (tally mode, every band: preset questions with at most 8 categories entered on steppers, a chart once five or more answers are in, claim tiles composed from the counts, Pro loads a made-up other class and compares shares in the table, the open level adds charts to a class pool for the projector; score = charts made, label '<n> charts made', BRB.gameOver with the charts at Finish); Explorer plays 1-3 and 7, Pro plays 4-7 with 1 as review (Explorer stars show silver for Pro). Daily Crew Challenge: one case per UTC day and band (Oomba.rand over the day number), seeded by the day, its own three-star card, never reported. Pair mode: Two on one device on the map and the Quest Card, whose turn in the HUD (the player's avatar, then a kit cat), Swap! banner every third case. Chapter crowns: every star in a chapter recolors Dot's coat and puts a crown on her (cosmetic, saved). Keyboard: arrows walk table rows and headers and the buttons of any row or grid (tools, steppers, bars, claim tiles, the keypad, the chapter tiles), Tab moves between panels, digits pick claim tiles. Settings parity with kit games: the kit settings open from the title cog, the pause screen and the Quest Card; reduced motion stops the game's own transitions and bursts; captions and read-aloud cover Dot, the case files and the learn cards while they are open; left-handed moves the HUD buttons, the steppers' - and + and the side-by-side work panel to the left; a check mark sits next to every color cue (proved rows and bars, pressed chips and band buttons); at 125% or 150% text a phone drops the duplicate notes so the claim button stays in view. Lesson mode = BRB.params ({chapter, band, mode, level, lock}, read as (window.BRB && BRB.params) || {}) or a 4-digit quest code C B M L typed on the in-game keypad (digits in groups with spaces, hidden in live frames; params win over codes): skips the chapter map, shows 'Class quest: <chapter> · <band>', enables the Case-closed card (3-tile check + a confidence face) and with lock=1 hides the map and the band toggle; at chapter end the results card says the work is saved. Progress: after every solved or skipped case BRB.score.submit(starsInChapter, '<done>/<total> cases, <stars> stars[, <ok>/<n> checks]'), BRB.gameOver({won: true, score}) at chapter end, BRB.progress({game: 'dd', ...}) when the SDK has it. Modes: play, tally (My Data), projector (bigger text, nothing saved). Saves in BRB.storage 'data-detective-v1' (band, stars per level, learn cards seen, pairs). Words: English is the key (window.DataDetectiveT), other languages are reviewed data packs under /vendor/data/data-detective/<PACK_VER>/<lang>.js read from window.CsqPacks (scripts/cs-quest-i18n.mjs). The quest-code codec (engine codeOf / parseCode) round-trips every chapter, band, mode and level. Test hooks: __brbTest.start({chapter, band, mode, level, seed, lesson, lock, pairs, daily, day}), step, skipAnimations, cover, state, act, tap, claim (an index, or an array for a pick-two case), claimCard, hint, skip, solve, closeDialog, params, code, questCard, keypad, map, levels, daily, dailyLevel, openChoice, pool, textSize; deterministic layouts and trials from seed.

pt.description: Resolva mistérios com dados! A raposa detetive Dot entrega fichas de casos: ordene e agrupe uma tabela até a resposta aparecer, escolha o gráfico que responde à pergunta, decida se uma afirmação é comprovada ou se ainda é cedo para dizer, limpe listas bagunçadas, compare com justiça usando porcentagem, ajuste um modelo até ele combinar com os testes (e equilibre um jogo de corrida), descubra pesquisas tendenciosas e quem ficou de fora, e conte a pesquisa da sua turma num gráfico com uma afirmação justa. A regra do Mostre-me: só afirme quando a visualização comprova, depois toque na evidência. Casos Explorador e Pro, estrelas, desafio diário, sem digitar.

fr.description: Résous des mystères avec des données ! Dot, la renarde détective, te confie des dossiers : trie et regroupe un tableau jusqu’à ce que la réponse saute aux yeux, choisis le graphique qui répond à la question, juge si une affirmation est prouvée ou s’il est trop tôt pour le dire, nettoie des listes en désordre, compare équitablement avec des pourcentages, ajuste un modèle jusqu’à ce qu’il colle aux essais (et équilibre un jeu de course), repère les sondages biaisés et qui a été oublié, et compte le sondage de ta classe pour en faire un graphique et une affirmation juste. La règle Montre-moi : n’affirme que si la vue le prouve, puis touche la preuve. Enquêtes Explorateur et Pro, étoiles, défi du jour, sans clavier.

es.description: ¡Resuelve misterios con datos! Dot, la zorra detective, te entrega expedientes: ordena y agrupa una tabla hasta que salte la respuesta, elige el gráfico que responde a la pregunta, decide si una afirmación está demostrada o si aún es pronto para saberlo, limpia listas desordenadas, compara con justicia usando porcentajes, ajusta un modelo hasta que encaje con las pruebas (y equilibra un juego de carreras), detecta encuestas sesgadas y a quién dejaron fuera, y cuenta la encuesta de tu clase para hacer un gráfico y una afirmación justa. La regla Muéstramelo: afirma solo cuando la vista lo demuestre y luego toca la evidencia. Casos Explorador y Pro, estrellas, reto diario, sin escribir.

de.description: Löse Rätsel mit Daten! Die Fuchsdetektivin Dot gibt dir Fallakten: Sortiere und gruppiere eine Tabelle, bis die Antwort ins Auge springt, wähle das Diagramm, das die Frage beantwortet, entscheide, ob eine Behauptung belegt ist oder es noch zu früh ist, räume unordentliche Listen auf, vergleiche fair mit Prozent, verbessere ein Modell, bis es zu den Versuchen passt (und balanciere ein Laufspiel), entlarve verzerrte Umfragen und finde heraus, wer fehlt, und werte die Umfrage deiner Klasse zu einem Diagramm und einer fairen Aussage aus. Die Zeig-es-mir-Regel: Behaupte nur, was die Ansicht belegt, und tippe dann auf den Beweis. Entdecker- und Profi-Fälle, Sterne, Tagesaufgabe, ohne Tippen.

he.description: פתרו תעלומות בעזרת נתונים! דוט, השועלה הבלשית, מוסרת לכם תיקי חקירה: מיינו וקבצו טבלה עד שהתשובה קופצת, בחרו את התרשים שעונה על השאלה, החליטו אם טענה מוכחת או שמוקדם מדי לדעת, נקו רשימות מבולגנות, השוו בהגינות בעזרת אחוזים, שפרו מודל עד שהוא מתאים לניסויים (ואזנו משחק ריצה), גלו סקרים מוטים ומי נשאר בחוץ, וספרו את הסקר של הכיתה שלכם לתרשים ולטענה הוגנת. כלל ה״תראו לי״: טענו רק כשהתצוגה מוכיחה, ואז הקישו על הראיה. תיקים לחוקרים ולמקצוענים, כוכבים, אתגר יומי, בלי הקלדה.

ja.description: データで なぞを とこう！きつねの たんてい ドットが じけんファイルを わたすよ。ひょうを ならべかえたり グループに わけたりして こたえを みつけよう。しつもんに こたえる グラフを えらび、その いいぶんが データで たしかめられるか、まだ わからないかを きめよう。ちらかった リストを きれいにし、パーセントで こうへいに くらべ、ためしの けっかに あうまで モデルを なおそう（はしる ゲームの バランスも）。かたよった アンケートや、だれが ぬけているかを 見つけ、クラスの アンケートを かぞえて グラフと こうへいな いいぶんに しよう。「見せて」の ルール：がめんが しょうめいする ときだけ いいぶんを えらび、しょうこを タップ。たんけんか と プロの じけん、ほし、まいにちの チャレンジ、もじ入力なし。
ja.tags: データ,グラフ,ひょう,ならべかえ,いいぶん,しょうこ,たんてい,りか,さんすう,まなび

ar.description: حُلّ الألغاز بالبيانات! تسلّمك المحققة الثعلبة دوت ملفات القضايا: رتّب الجدول وجمّعه حتى يظهر الجواب، واختر المخطط الذي يجيب عن السؤال، واحكم هل الادعاء مدعوم أم أن الوقت مبكر للحكم، ونظّف القوائم الفوضوية، وقارن بعدل بالنسبة المئوية، وحسّن نموذجًا حتى يطابق التجارب (ووازن لعبة جري)، واكتشف الاستطلاعات المنحازة ومن تُرك خارجها، واجمع استطلاع صفك في مخطط وادعاء عادل. قاعدة «أرِني»: لا تثبّت ادعاءً إلا عندما يدعمه العرض، ثم المس الدليل. قضايا المستكشف والمحترف، ونجوم، وتحدٍّ يومي، بلا كتابة.

ru.description: Раскрывай тайны с помощью данных! Лиса-детектив Дот выдаёт тебе дела: сортируй и группируй таблицу, пока ответ не станет очевиден, выбирай диаграмму, которая отвечает на вопрос, решай, подтверждено ли утверждение или судить ещё рано, приводи в порядок запутанные списки, сравнивай честно в процентах, улучшай модель, пока она не совпадёт с опытами (и настрой баланс игры-бегалки), находи предвзятые опросы и тех, кого забыли, и подсчитай опрос своего класса, чтобы получить диаграмму и честный вывод. Правило «Покажи»: делай вывод, только когда вид его подтверждает, потом нажми на доказательство. Дела для исследователей и профи, звёзды, ежедневное задание, без набора текста.

it.description: Risolvi misteri con i dati! Dot, la volpe detective, ti consegna i fascicoli: ordina e raggruppa una tabella finché la risposta salta fuori, scegli il grafico che risponde alla domanda, giudica se un’affermazione è dimostrata o se è troppo presto per dirlo, sistema elenchi disordinati, confronta in modo equo con le percentuali, migliora un modello finché combacia con le prove (e bilancia un gioco di corsa), scopri i sondaggi di parte e chi è stato escluso, e conta il sondaggio della tua classe per farne un grafico e un’affermazione equa. La regola Fammi vedere: afferma solo quando la vista lo dimostra, poi tocca la prova. Casi Esploratore e Pro, stelle, sfida del giorno, senza scrivere.

zh-Hant.description: 用資料破解謎團！狐狸偵探小點交給你案件檔案：把表格排序、分組，直到答案浮現；挑出能回答問題的圖表；判斷一個說法有證據支持，還是現在下結論太早；整理亂七八糟的清單；用百分比公平比較；調整模型直到符合試驗結果（還要平衡一個跑步遊戲）；找出有偏差的調查和被漏掉的人；再把全班的調查統計成圖表和公平的說法。「給我看」規則：只有畫面能證明時才提出說法，然後點選證據。探險家和專家案件、星星、每日挑戰，不用打字。
zh-Hant.tags: 資料,圖表,表格,排序,說法,證據,偵探,科學,數學,學習

nl.description: Los mysteries op met data! Vossendetective Dot geeft je dossiers: sorteer en groepeer een tabel tot het antwoord eruit springt, kies de grafiek die de vraag beantwoordt, beoordeel of een bewering bewezen is of dat het nog te vroeg is, ruim rommelige lijsten op, vergelijk eerlijk met procenten, verbeter een model tot het bij de proeven past (en balanceer een renspel), ontdek bevooroordeelde enquêtes en wie er werd vergeten, en tel de enquête van je klas op tot een grafiek en een eerlijke bewering. De Laat-zien-regel: beweer alleen iets als de weergave het bewijst, en tik dan op het bewijs. Ontdekker- en Pro-zaken, sterren, dagelijkse uitdaging, zonder typen.
